description: This React component handles the booking modal for a smart parking reservation system. It allows users to confirm a parking slot reservation, interacts with an API endpoint to create the booking, and displays a QR code for the reservation.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a reservation request to the backend API, handles fallback to mock data if API call fails, updates the booking state, and manages the busy indicator.
